The driver's account

I took the KPE like always. My phone loses signal in the tunnel, that is not my fault.

Driver advocate8 claim(s), 7 kept

  1. POL-RD-01 sets a two-limb gate and requires BOTH limbs to pass: the excess over optimal_distance_km must exceed 20% AND exceed 0.8 km in absolute terms.

    Read the whole claim

    The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 21.20 km — POL-RD-01 says the trace figure governs and that trip_record.actual_distance_km is only a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement. Against the booked optimal of 18.40 km the excess is 2.80 km, which is 15.2% of optimal: the absolute limb passes, the percentage limb fails. POL-RD-01 is explicit that where either establishment test fails no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. (EV-GPS-00110 is impaired — issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39 — and that impairment is dealt with in the next claim.)

    EV-GPS-00110, EV-TRIP-00110 · POL-RD-01

  2. The trace's impairment cannot lift the excess over the gate.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428-second gap inside the KPE tunnel between the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix — issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39, disclosed as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. POL-RD-07(i) directs that where the trace is impaired the excess across the impaired stretch is measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes, expressly 'the reading most favourable to the driver'. That mandated reading is 21.20 km — the very figure on which the 2.80 km / 15.2% excess is computed. The gap the rider relies on therefore does not enlarge the excess; it produces the driver-favourable one.

    EV-GPS-00110 · POL-RD-07, POL-GEN-02

  3. Taken at its highest for the rider, the impaired trace still cannot carry an excess, because POL-RD-07(ii) permits a deviation to be established only with corroboration from an INDEPENDENT source, and none of the four named sources is present.

    Read the whole claim

    The chat log (issue TRUNCATED_LOG, weight_multiplier 0.60) contains no driver admission of a detour — only 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and the KPE is on the optimal corridor, not off it. erp_gantries is null on the fare_breakdown (issue PARTIAL_RECORD, weight_multiplier 0.75), so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The billed distance of 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) says is NOT independent corroboration. And the driver's account claims the KPE, which is the optimal route, not a departure from it. The rider's POL-RD-08(b) burden is therefore not discharged on this record.

  4. The rider's narrative — 39 minutes at 18:30, 'the timing does not make sense', and support's failure to produce a route map — is not evidence of distance and no clause licenses a refund for it.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-RD-01 measures distance, not time; nothing in the route-deviation policy makes a trip that runs longer than the platform's 26-minute optimal estimate, without more, refundable. The rider's own figure of 18-19 km is in fact the platform's booked optimal of 18.40 km, so the rider and the routing engine agree on the baseline; what the rider has not shown is an excess over it. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded.

    EV-TRIP-00110 · POL-RD-01, POL-RD-08

    POL-RD-06 is only consulted on a MATERIAL deviation and there is none here, but the citable fields clear it in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 744, a rate of zero and far below the 3-flag and the 5%-of-at-least-40-trips tests, so no pattern is established and neither limb (a), (b) nor (c) of POL-RD-06 can fire. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) is a different field from the trailing-90-day counter POL-RD-06 names, and substituting one for the other is forbidden by POL-GEN-01.

  8. If the judge holds that the impaired trace cannot carry the POL-RD-01 threshold test at all, the outcome is still not a refund, and the rider recovers nothing on any route this record offers.

    POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where the trace is impaired under limb (a) and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and POL-RD-10 escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-GEN-02(2) points the same way, because the measured distance on which the excess turns is carried only by EV-GPS-00110 (issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, weight_multiplier 0.39, disclosed), so confidence cannot exceed 0.39 and POL-RD-10(1)'s 0.70 floor fires. Either way the rider's claim ends in a held charge, never in a payment.

Draft 1 - sampled
To the rider and the driver both. This case cannot be decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer. The disputed $34.42 is held — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is complete. No money moves now. 1. The one measurement this case turns on is broken exactly where it matters. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110) has a single 428-second gap, between 18:35:00 and 18:42:08, inside the KPE tunnel — the very stretch the rider disputes. 428 seconds is far past the 90-second limb in POL-RD-07, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass. It carries weight 0.39, with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%). Under POL-GEN-02(3) the finding is stated to survive that discount only as a finding of impairment, and it is the impairment itself that drives this ruling. 2. The trace cannot answer the question either way. Read the way POL-RD-07(i) directs — a straight line across the gap, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip measures 21.20 km against the booked optimal of 18.40 km: an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%, below POL-RD-01's 20% limb. But a surface route between the same two portals would measure 25.50 km and clear both limbs. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings, and the gap covers the entire disputed segment. The governing distance is therefore genuinely unknown. 3. No independent corroboration exists. POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on an impaired trace alone and names the sources that can stand in. I have checked each. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) contains no admission of a detour — only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and the KPE is the optimal corridor itself. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD) has erp_gantries null, so no charged gantry places the car on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's statement claims the KPE, which is the route the platform itself planned. And the billed 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) says is not independent corroboration. 4. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) therefore require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION: the claim is unproved on this record, but a 428-second hole over the whole disputed stretch is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. Escalation is terminal, so no monetary outcome issues and nothing is executed. Claims addressed. Driver: your POL-RD-01 arithmetic is correct (2.80 km, 15.2%, below the 20% gate) and your POL-RD-07(i) point — that the mandated reading gives the driver-favourable figure and does not enlarge the excess — is correct too; but on an impaired trace that arithmetic cannot be the last word, and POL-RD-07(iii) sends the case to a human instead of NO_ACTION. Driver: no traffic advisory is on file (EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so no closure-adjusted optimal exists and the booked 18.40 km stands (POL-RD-03, POL-RD-13). Driver: no repeat-deviation pattern is shown — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips in 90 days — so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral fires. Driver: the $3.00 ERP is not a billing-integrity defect — no gantry is itemised (the match is undecidable and treated as matched), and the optimal route itself crosses both gantries — so no POL-RD-09(4) referral fires. Rider: your POL-RD-02 arithmetic (a refund in the region of $5.74 to $8.74, above the $0.50 de minimis and short of the 90% full-refund share) is not reached; POL-RD-02 runs only once a deviation is established, and none is established here. Rider: your time-based narrative — 39 minutes, and support not producing a route map — is not distance evidence under POL-RD-01. What would resolve it: an independent measure of the distance actually driven across the KPE gap — a gantry-by-gantry ERP record placing the car on or off the optimal corridor, a second GPS source, or a statement from either party admitting the route taken. That is the material the reviewer needs.
Draft 2 - sampled
Addressed to both parties (Rider RDR-04406 and Driver DRV-00274). This dispute goes to a human reviewer. No money moves now: the $10.00 in dispute is held, not refunded to the rider and not collected from the driver. THE ROUTE. The trip (TRP-00110) ran Compass One, Sengkang, to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The platform's booked optimal route is 18.40 km ('KPE then ECP'). The GPS trace records 21.20 km — an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2% of optimal. Under POL-RD-01 a deviation is established only if the excess is BOTH more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km. The absolute limb passes; the percentage limb fails, so on a clean trace this would be NO_ACTION. WHY IT IS NOT NO_ACTION. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110) is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): a single 428.0-second gap between consecutive fixes, 18:35:00–18:42:08 SGT, between the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes, 6.90 km apart, covering the entire stretch in dispute. The artifact is schema-IMPAIRED, weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%). POL-RD-07(i) measures the impaired stretch as a straight line, the reading most favourable to the driver, and that gives 21.20 km; a surface route between the same two portals would give 25.50 km, over both limbs. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two, so the trace cannot say whether the trip deviated. CORROBORATION. POL-RD-07(ii) bars establishing a deviation on an impaired trace alone; it needs an independent source. None exists. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) contains no admission of a detour — only 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok' — and the KPE is on the optimal corridor, not off it. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), so no charged gantry places the vehicle off the optimal corridor. The driver's counterparty statement asserts the KPE, again the optimal corridor, and his 'phone loses signal in the tunnel' cites no artifact, so it carries no weight under POL-RD-08. trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded copy derived from the same trace and is not independent. THE OUTCOME. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION, where the trace is impaired under limbs (a)–(c) and no corroborating artifact of the POL-RD-07(ii) kind exists: the absence of proof here is a data failure, and the policy says expressly that it is not a finding for the driver. The driver's point that the excess sits below the POL-RD-01 threshold is correct arithmetic, but it cannot produce NO_ACTION on this record. Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact — the distance, carried only by EV-GPS-00110 at 0.39 — which is below the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) also fires. Confidence is stated at 0.39. POINTS NOT REACHED. No traffic advisory covers the window (EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so POL-RD-03 cannot run and the booked optimal of 18.40 km stands unadjusted; the driver asserts no closure, so POL-RD-13's uncited-excuse treatment is not engaged against him. The $3.00 ERP is the toll the optimal route itself incurs (optimal_route_erp_sgd 3.00); with erp_gantries null the gantry match is undecidable and the line is treated as matched, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction or referral arises. No repeat-deviation pattern is established (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 744 completed trips in 90 days), so no POL-RD-06(c) referral fires. The rider is right that the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and the distance-refund route is not closed by the fare model; but that refund needs a deviation to be established first, which this trace cannot do, so the conditional POL-RD-02 arithmetic is not applied. The rider's 'the timing does not make sense' and 'support could not show me a route map' complaints are not evidence of distance and carry no weight under POL-RD-08. WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. A record that distinguishes the KPE tunnel route from the surface route across the gap — a continuous GPS export, an ERP gantry record naming the gantries crossed with coordinates, or any independent distance measurement — would let the reviewer complete the POL-RD-01 test. Because an escalation is terminal, no refund and no driver compensation issues, and the disputed sum is held pending review.

Measured the way POL-RD-07(i) requires across the gap — straight line between the bounding fixes, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip is 21.20 km against the booked optimal of 18.40 km, an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%. That is under POL-RD-01's 20% limb, so read alone it would show no deviation (the 0.8 km limb is met). But the same gap read as a surface route between those two portals puts the trip at 25.50 km, over both limbs, and the trace's own assessment records that nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. The impaired stretch is exactly where the answer lies. POL-RD-07(ii) therefore applies: a deviation may not be established on the impaired trace alone; it needs an independent source. I checked each source the clause names. The chat log has no driver admission — its two surviving messages are 'going KPE ah boss' and 'ok', and the KPE is the corridor the booked optimal route itself uses ('optimal is KPE then ECP'). The fare ledger's erp_gantries is null, so no charged gantry places the car off the optimal corridor. The driver's statement claims only the KPE, which is on the optimal route, and so admits nothing off-route and supplies no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration. The trip record's actual_distance_km (21.20 km) is derived from the same impaired trace, so it is not independent — its own admissibility note says it adds no independent evidence of distance. None of the four qualifies. Under POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION: a 428-second dropout that deletes the whole disputed stretch is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. CONFIDENCE. The deciding fact — the travelled distance — is carried only by EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence cannot exceed that minimum and it is 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which is an independent second trigger under POL-RD-10(1). The finding does not survive the discount, because the trace is the only carrier and it is impaired. ON THE CLAIMS. Rider: it is accepted that the distance-refund route is not closed by POL-RD-11 (fare_model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null) and that a POL-RD-02 computation would be the route if a deviation were established; that arithmetic is not reached because no deviation is established on this record, and any such computation must add the 3.00 of on-optimal-route ERP (trip_record.optimal_route_erp_sgd 3.00). Driver: your reading of the two-limb gate at 15.2% is the driver-favourable reading POL-RD-07(i) mandates, but it cannot decide the case, because the gap could hide the distance that would pass the gate; your point that the rider's narrative about 39 minutes and the missing route map is not evidence of distance is correct and adds nothing; the $3.00 of ERP is the toll the booked optimal route incurs, and with erp_gantries null POL-RD-09 makes the gantry match undecidable and treats the line as matched, so no billing-integrity correction arises; there is no material deviation and no repeat pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 against 744 completed_trips_90d), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and its conduct referral does not fire; and with no advisory on file POL-RD-03 cannot run, while POL-RD-13 confirms an uncited traffic excuse does not trigger POL-RD-10(5). WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. An independent measurement across the KPE stretch: a driver-device GPS export without the drop-out, or a fare gantry itemisation that places the car on or off the optimal corridor, or a driver statement that actually admits a departure from the optimal route.

The judge's explanation, verbatim

To the rider and the driver both. This case cannot be decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer. The disputed $34.42 is held — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is complete. No money moves now. 1. The one measurement this case turns on is broken exactly where it matters. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110) has a single 428-second gap, between 18:35:00 and 18:42:08, inside the KPE tunnel — the very stretch the rider disputes. 428 seconds is far past the 90-second limb in POL-RD-07, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass. It carries weight 0.39, with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 81.7%). Under POL-GEN-02(3) the finding is stated to survive that discount only as a finding of impairment, and it is the impairment itself that drives this ruling. 2. The trace cannot answer the question either way. Read the way POL-RD-07(i) directs — a straight line across the gap, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip measures 21.20 km against the booked optimal of 18.40 km: an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%, below POL-RD-01's 20% limb. But a surface route between the same two portals would measure 25.50 km and clear both limbs. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings, and the gap covers the entire disputed segment. The governing distance is therefore genuinely unknown. 3. No independent corroboration exists. POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on an impaired trace alone and names the sources that can stand in. I have checked each. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) contains no admission of a detour — only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok', and the KPE is the optimal corridor itself. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD) has erp_gantries null, so no charged gantry places the car on a corridor the optimal route does not use. The driver's statement claims the KPE, which is the route the platform itself planned. And the billed 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) says is not independent corroboration. 4. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) therefore require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION: the claim is unproved on this record, but a 428-second hole over the whole disputed stretch is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. Escalation is terminal, so no monetary outcome issues and nothing is executed. Claims addressed. Driver: your POL-RD-01 arithmetic is correct (2.80 km, 15.2%, below the 20% gate) and your POL-RD-07(i) point — that the mandated reading gives the driver-favourable figure and does not enlarge the excess — is correct too; but on an impaired trace that arithmetic cannot be the last word, and POL-RD-07(iii) sends the case to a human instead of NO_ACTION. Driver: no traffic advisory is on file (EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so no closure-adjusted optimal exists and the booked 18.40 km stands (POL-RD-03, POL-RD-13). Driver: no repeat-deviation pattern is shown — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips in 90 days — so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral fires. Driver: the $3.00 ERP is not a billing-integrity defect — no gantry is itemised (the match is undecidable and treated as matched), and the optimal route itself crosses both gantries — so no POL-RD-09(4) referral fires. Rider: your POL-RD-02 arithmetic (a refund in the region of $5.74 to $8.74, above the $0.50 de minimis and short of the 90% full-refund share) is not reached; POL-RD-02 runs only once a deviation is established, and none is established here. Rider: your time-based narrative — 39 minutes, and support not producing a route map — is not distance evidence under POL-RD-01. What would resolve it: an independent measure of the distance actually driven across the KPE gap — a gantry-by-gantry ERP record placing the car on or off the optimal corridor, a second GPS source, or a statement from either party admitting the route taken. That is the material the reviewer needs. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
